howto.what: 装上后，你可以通过终端使用 playwright-cli 驱动浏览器：对页面进行快照，然后通过引用（ref）对元素进行操作，如点击、填写、选择等。
howto.when: 当需要自动化浏览器交互、填写网页表单、测试 UI 或从命令行驱动已登录的 Web 应用时触发。

howto.what_en: This skill enables you to drive a browser from the terminal using playwright-cli: take a snapshot of the page, then act on elements by their reference (ref) such as clicking, filling, selecting, etc.
howto.when_en: Use when automating browser interactions, filling web forms, testing UIs, or driving logged-in web apps from the command line.
